slides.what_it_does: Four mana 2/4. If you would draw a card, you draw two instead. Every draw, not just your draw step.
slides.best_home: Blue decks that already draw. On its own it does nothing. Next to a draw engine it doubles the whole thing.
slides.take: Put a second draw doubler alongside it and you get four cards, not three. The two effects feed each other.

cards.name: Captain Kathryn Janeway
cards.take: Four mana in green. An extra land drop every turn, and every creature you play explores.

cards.name: Crystalline Entity
cards.take: Eight mana 7/7 flier. Cast it and every nonartifact creature dies. It isn't one.

cards.name: The Unicomplex
cards.take: A land. Untapped if you already have two, and it either surveils or puts a creature back on top.

slides.question: Is Spock making your deck, or is four mana too much for a body that does nothing?
